scope: Three own synthetic shared-bogie captures at 35/75m odometer targets, including a lateral view, on real hardware and paused after real driving. Numerical force, reverse and restoration acceptance is recorded by CPU tests; this is not a native OR route comparison.

observations: Both owned synthetic bodies follow the curved track without a discontinuity at their connection.
One BOGIE2 shared mesh binding remains and the flexible endpoint error is zero in each paused capture.
The red/blue boxes are owned diagnostic meshes, not original vehicle appearance or detailed wheel/rail contact certification.
limits: Captures pause after real driving; they do not by themselves certify every animation frame, reversing or force parity. Numerical reverse, force and save/restore acceptance is separate.
The viewer was built before the final ACT importer corrections. Those changes do not affect the synthetic bogie scenario; the recorded render/physics source hashes remain unchanged.

unaccepted_setup_attempt.reason: Capture watchdog was set to one second and exited before reaching 35m. Its report is not acceptance; the observation timeout was corrected without changing model, target or tolerances.
